items.title: General Mills (GIS) Reshapes Leadership And Operating Structure In Growth Push
items.summary: General Mills (NYSE:GIS) announced a broad organizational restructuring and executive leadership changes aimed at accelerating growth across the group. The updated operating model divides the business into distinct segments and introduces a unified Commercial function to coordinate go to market activity.
